title: Fitting ideal factorization after an etale localization
statement: Let $A\to C$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, and let $d\ge0$ be an integer such that $C$ is a free $A$-module with a basis of $d$ elements [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Let $h\in C$ and let $C_h$ be the localization at the powers of $h$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away]. Assume $\operatorname{Spec}C_h\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Let $K\subset C$ be an ideal and put $M=C/K$. Choose any surjective $A$-linear map $\pi:A^{\oplus n}\twoheadrightarrow M$, with $n\ge0$, and let $I_0(\pi)\subset A$ be the zeroth kernel-minor ideal defined in [lem-trf-fitting-ideal-independence-base-change]. There exists an ideal $L\subset C_h$ such that $I_0(\pi)C_h=(KC_h)L$. If $K$ is finitely generated as an ideal of $C$, then $I_0(\pi)$ is finitely generated as an ideal of $A$, and $L$ can be chosen finitely generated as an ideal of $C_h$. Here extensions of ideals are the ideals generated by their images under the indicated ring maps.

source.place: Tag 0812 (lemma-trick-fitting-ideal), specialized from finite locally free rank d to a finite free algebra. The zeroth Fitting ideal is the kernel-minor ideal of 07Z8; the affine etale convention is identified with ring-etaleness by 02GJ.

proof.text: Set $B=C_h$. By [lem-trf-etale-tensor-splitting], choose a commutative $B$-algebra $D$ and $\theta:C\otimes_A B\cong B\times D$ whose first projection is $c\otimes b\mapsto\bar c b$. Apply [lem-trf-split-tensor-quotient-decomposition] with $f:C\to B$ the localization map and the given basis of $C$. It supplies the ideal $H\subset D$ and a $B$-linear isomorphism $(C/K)\otimes_A B\cong(B/KB)\oplus(D/H)$, with both summands finitely generated.

source.place: Tag 0812 (lemma-trick-fitting-ideal), product splitting and quotient decomposition.

proof.text: Base change of $\pi$ has zeroth kernel-minor ideal $I_0(\pi)B$ by [lem-trf-fitting-ideal-independence-base-change]. Composing a surjection with an isomorphism does not change its kernel. Thus the decomposition of Step 1 and [lem-trf-fitting-ideal-direct-sum] give $I_0(\pi)B=I_0(B/KB)I_0(D/H)$. For $B\twoheadrightarrow B/KB$, the kernel is $KB$ and its $1\times1$ kernel minors are the elements of $KB$; hence independence gives $I_0(B/KB)=KB$. Set $L=I_0(D/H)$. Then $I_0(\pi)C_h=(KC_h)L$.

source.place: Tag 0812 (lemma-trick-fitting-ideal), final Fitting product equality, using Tag 07ZA(2),(3),(8).

proof.text: If $K$ is finitely generated, choose generators $k_1,\ldots,k_r$. Apply [lem-trf-split-tensor-quotient-finite-fitting] to the same $A,C,B,D,\theta,K$ and the chosen basis. It gives finite presentations and finite determinant generating sets for $I_0(C/K)\subset A$ and $I_0(D/H)\subset B$. Independence [lem-trf-fitting-ideal-independence-base-change] identifies the first with $I_0(\pi)$; the second is precisely the already chosen $L$. This proves the conditional finite-generation assertion for that same factor.

lean.statement: theorem exists_fg_fitting_factor (A : Type u) (C : Type v) [CommRing A] [CommRing C] [Algebra A C] (d : ℕ) (b : Module.Basis (Fin d) A C) (h : C) [AlgebraicGeometry.Etale (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (RingHom.ulift.{max u v, max u v, u, v} (algebraMap A (Localization.Away h)))))] (K : Ideal C) (n : ℕ) (π : (Fin n → A) →ₗ[A] C ⧸ K) (hπ : Function.Surjective π) : ∃ (L : Ideal (Localization.Away h)), Ideal.map (algebraMap A (Localization.Away h)) (π.presentationFittingIdeal 0) = Ideal.map (algebraMap C (Localization.Away h)) K * L ∧ (K.FG → (π.presentationFittingIdeal 0).FG ∧ L.FG)
